title: 思考的代价：推理努力作为模型特定的API契约
summary: 该研究将API购买视为包含推理努力条款的契约，通过对比Sonnet 5显式高努力与省略努力条款的调用，发现显式高努力使每次调用成本增加约0.010美元，但未检测到准确率显著差异。研究强调推理努力是模型特定的API契约要素，影响成本与性能。
summary_en: This study treats API purchases as contracts including reasoning-effort terms. Comparing Sonnet 5 with explicit high effort versus omitted effort, it found higher cost per call but no significant accuracy difference, highlighting reasoning effort as a model-specific API contract element.
